Oil Marketing Companies Increase Commercial LPG and Aviation Fuel Prices

01 Nov 2026, 11:22 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily World Desk · Source: www.thehindu.com

Image: Saptaparno Ghosh · Source image rights not independently verified · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9 for the website

Price Adjustments Overview

Effective November 1, 2026, oil-marketing companies have implemented a price increase for commercial liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) cylinders. The adjustment follows recent market trends, marking the third consecutive hike for the 19-kg commercial cylinder since August.

Key Price Revisions

  • Commercial LPG (19-kg): Prices have risen by approximately ₹10 per cylinder nationwide.
  • Free-Trade LPG (5-kg): Refills for this category, often utilized by migrant workers, have seen an increase of about ₹2.5 per cylinder.
  • Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF): Prices for domestic carriers were raised by ₹1.37 per litre, bringing the cost to ₹138.5 per litre.
  • Domestic LPG: Prices for residential cylinders remain unchanged at this time.

Regional Impact

According to reported figures, the cost of a 19-kg commercial cylinder varies by region due to local taxes and logistics:

  • Delhi: Price increased to ₹2,820.
  • Mumbai: Price increased to ₹2,775.
  • Kolkata: Price increased to ₹2,971.
  • Chennai: Price increased to ₹2,994.5.

Market Context

State-owned oil-marketing companies have noted a rise in projected under-recoveries for LPG, estimating figures between ₹309 and ₹328 per cylinder for November, with projections climbing to ₹370 per cylinder in December. These companies have attributed recent volatility to fluctuations in benchmark Saudi CP prices.

Despite these adjustments, commercial LPG accounts for approximately 9.3% of total bottled hydrocarbon gas consumption in India. Government provisional data indicates an overall year-over-year decline in LPG consumption of 12.1% as of October 2026, even as fuel consumption in other sectors, such as diesel and petrol, showed growth.

How to Verify Current Rates

Consumers can verify the updated rates for commercial and domestic LPG by visiting the official websites or mobile applications of major oil-marketing companies, including Indian Oil Corporation (IOCL), Bharat Petroleum (BPCL), and Hindustan Petroleum (HPCL).
